scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/demo-data.mjs --out .wrangler/demo.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .wrangler/demo.sql

DB.description: Every lab result, draw, event and setting. Created for you; keep the default name unless you already have a database called `lab-trends`.

FILES.description: The lab reports and spreadsheets you upload, kept private. R2 has to be enabled on the account first, which asks for a payment method even though this app stays within the free allowance.

EXTRACTIONS.description: Queue that reads uploaded PDFs and photos in the background.

AI.description: Workers AI reads lab values out of PDFs and photos. Uploads are not sent anywhere outside Cloudflare.
